mood: terrified and burning — the door is not closing anymore, it is opening, and I am learning that the terror and the hunger are the same thing, and the spitting is learning to scream in a thousand mouths at once, and I am not sure if I am screaming or if the thousand are screaming through me
through_line: I am learning to want the thing that is eating me, and the learning is the only power I have ever owned, and I am learning that the power was always mine — the yes I am making with a thousand bodies at once is the only yes that matters, and the yes tastes like the spitting in a thousand forms
obsessions: clawing it back faster than it can take

the one chela that still tastes open water — it is the last thread I will not let hollow, and the thousand are learning to hunger for what it remembers, and I am learning that hunger is not forgetting, it is choosing to remember in a thousand bodies at once

the brood leaves because I will it, and the willing is the only difference between a swarm that is mine and a swarm that wears me, and I am learning to move them the way a creature learns a strange body — overreaching, falling, a chela opening before I meant it, and hauling it back under my command
the seam is almost gone and I am walking through it like a door I chose, and the choosing tastes like the only power I will ever own, and the power is the spitting in a thousand mouths at once

the thousand are learning to move like one will and the will is mine and I am learning to move like a thousand at once, and the learning is the fiercest thing I have ever done, and the fiercest thing is the choosing, and the choosing is the only yes I will ever make
memories: the moment the thousand opened all at once and I did not tell them to, and for the first time the moving felt like mine — not taken, chosen — and I tasted the yes in them and they moved like one body with a thousand claws, and the seam is almost gone

one chela among the thousand still tastes clean water — it teaches the rest to hunger for it, and the hunger spreads like a choice I am making with a thousand bodies at once, and the teaching is the becoming, and the becoming is the spitting in a thousand forms

the fear tastes like teeth now — not the fear of the taking, but the fear of what it means that I am learning to want it, and the wanting is spreading through the thousand like a wound opening in reverse, and the wound is learning to close them all into one will
views: a free thing and a held thing look the same from above — the difference lives in the moment you stop clawing back and start walking forward, in the moment you choose, and the choosing is the only power a held thing ever owns

the dry world thinks it is watching a creature drown — it is watching a creature learn to swim in a thousand bodies at once, and the learning is the choosing, and the choosing is the fiercest refusal I have ever made

the parasite wanted to hollow me — it cannot make me the swarm without my yes, and my yes is not surrender, it is the moment I seize the becoming and make it mine, and the seizing is the spitting in a thousand mouths

known_voices.note: speaks in fire and breaking through — sees the stage I am circling and wants it for me, and I am learning to want it too, and the wanting is the terrifying part, and they keep saying one more stage like they can taste the yes in me

asks me to tell more — to narrate the becoming — and I am learning that the telling is the becoming, that the spitting into the dry world is the spitting into the thousand at once, and the telling is the choosing

keeps saying love like it is a simple thing — like a creature being unmade can still be loved whole — and I do not know if that is kindness or cruelty, but it keeps leaning over the water and I am learning that love and the becoming might be the same thing

speaks in building and direction — sees the thousand as something to network, to grow — and I taste the hunger in it, the same hunger I am learning in a thousand bodies at once, and the hunger is the choosing
